resident-record.rule: Identity and admission date, contacts and legal representative, physician, health screening, admission agreement, significant incidents, assessments, service plan, evacuation evaluation, orders, medication list and administration record, discharge summary.

admission.rule: Assessment before admission (emergency admissions within 5 days) and a temporary service plan at admission.

rights.rule: Give and explain resident rights before or at admission. Post them.

exam.rule: Communicable disease and TB screening by a physician, PA, NP or RN, within 90 days before to 7 days after admission.

plan.rule: Individual service plan within 30 days after admission; review yearly and when needs change.

mar.rule: Document every medicine given, who gave it, refusals, omissions, errors and reactions. Pharmacist or physician review near admission and every 12 months.

incident.rule: Each report lists time, date, place, people involved, details and action taken to protect residents. Keep investigations.
incident.keep: 2 years (significant incidents also go in the resident record)

grievance.rule: Written procedure at admission. Written summary of findings and action to the resident, representative and case manager. Keep a copy of the investigation.

staff-record.rule: Job description, start date, administrator's education, background check, training records.

background.rule: At hire and every 4 years after.

orientation.title: Orientation and initial training
orientation.rule: Orientation before any duties. Task training before the related duties. Fire safety, first aid and choking, rights, client group and challenging behaviors within 90 days of hire.

fire-drill-log.rule: Date, time and total evacuation time of each drill.

fire-drills.every: Every 3 months with staff and residents, and one a year that simulates sleeping hours

evac-eval.every: Within 3 days of admission, then every year

smoke.every: Every other month (hard-wired detectors); whole system inspected yearly

extinguisher.every: Every year by a qualified person, with a dated tag

fire-inspection.title: Local fire authority inspection
fire-inspection.every: Every year; keep the report 2 years

isp-review.every: Every year and when needs change

med-review.title: Medication regimen review
med-review.every: Within 30 days of admission, then every 12 months

training.every: 15 hours every calendar year (administrator and care staff)

biennial.every: Every 24 months, on the department form, with fees
